title: Rock paper scissors help ( rpg maker mz )

posts.author: poowee2323
posts.body:
Okay so in the main character's room there's a computer and when you interact, you get asked if you want to boot it up or not. If you choose yes, a picture of the computer wallpaper comes onto the screen and it asks you what you would like to do (play a game or log off) log off works fine, the picture disappears and stuff. The game is rock paper scissors. the actual game works fine, but when you've finished a round, it asks you if you want to boot up your computer again, this time with the computer wallpaper already on the screen. How do I fix this?
When you play a round of the game, I don't want it to close the whole computer either (get rid of the image), I just want it to go back to when it asks what you would like to do.

posts.author: Zia_
posts.body:
You can put a Label here, and call it something like "Restart Game".
At the end of the game, you put a "Go to Label" command and use this exact name.
It's basically a bookmark to tell the event, where to jump from here.
